lines.text: A plumber walked onto an active military base and stole a 57-ton combat tank.
Then took it on a rampage down a California highway.
In nineteen ninety-five, Shawn Nelson was furious after losing his plumbing business.
He bypassed armory security, popped open an M-sixty tank, and hotwired the engine.
Crashing through the base gates, he rolled straight onto San Diego streets.
He crushed forty parked cars, flattened utility poles, and ripped fire hydrants.
Police cruisers chased the tank helplessly, unable to pierce three-inch armor.
He charged onto the interstate, trying to cross over into opposing traffic.
Until the tank got high-centered on a heavy concrete highway divider.
Officers used bolt cutters to pop the hatch, ending the thirty-minute joyride.
Because even against fifty police cars, nobody could stop...
